author: golden state today
title: Steve Cortes: 'Radical governors like Gavin Newsom put lives in danger' by issuing commercial licenses to unqualified drivers
text:
Steve Cortes, president of the League of American Workers, expressed concerns on X regarding the issuance of commercial driver’s licenses. He said that governors like Gavin Newsom are endangering motorists by granting these licenses to individuals who may not be qualified, and he advocated for uniform national enforcement.
“Radical governors like Gavin Newsom put lives in danger all across America…by handing out CDL’s to unqualified truck drivers, including ILLEGALS,” said Cortes. “Safety rules only work when consistently enforced across all 50 states!”
In a related discussion, Chris Spear, President and CEO of the American Trucking Associations (ATA), addressed the revocation of 17,000 commercial driver’s licenses in California during an interview with NewsNation. Spear explained that the federal government is upholding driver-qualification standards and that the trucking industry supports initiatives to ensure states adhere to consistent conditions before issuing commercial licenses.
According to the ATA’s American Trucking Trends report, trucks transported 11.46 billion tons of freight in 2023. The report further highlights that trucking accounted for 72.6% of the nation’s freight tonnage. This significant reliance on trucking underscores the importance of maintaining consistent licensing standards for interstate safety.
The Bureau of Transportation Statistics indicates that trucks carry most U.S. goods moved over land, particularly on routes under 2,000 miles. These shipments frequently cross state borders as part of regular freight patterns, suggesting that inconsistent state licensing practices could impact roadway safety across the nation.
Cortes is not only the founder and president of the League of American Workers but also serves as a senior political advisor to CatholicVote. His previous roles include serving as a senior advisor to President Donald Trump and Senator JD Vance and working as an on-air commentator for Fox News and CNN. Additionally, Cortes produces columns and documentaries at Cortes Investigates.
